hints.title: Run Length Encoding In Place
hints.text: Contiguous runs of identical characters compress into the character followed by the decimal count string if the count strictly exceeds one.

hints.title: Write Pointer Lag Invariant
hints.text: Because compressed lengths are always less than or equal to uncompressed lengths, a write pointer never overtakes the read pointer.

hints.title: Read Write Pointer Compression Procedure
hints.text: Initialize write pointer and read pointer at zero. For each distinct run, count matching characters. Write the character at write pointer. If count exceeds one, convert count to string and write each digit sequentially. Return the final write pointer index.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Constructing strings and converting back to character arrays uses extra memory, violating the in-place constant space requirement.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual read and write pointers compress the array in O(N) time using strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle counts greater than nine (multi-digit writing) and avoid writing count 1 for single characters.
